## GitLab MCP Server

The gitlab MCP server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants and agents to interact directly with GitLab projects and resources through a structured, AI-friendly interface. It allows AI-driven workflows to work with repositories, issues, merge requests, and project metadata without switching tools or manually navigating the GitLab UI. It is ideal for development, code review, CI/CD visibility, and project management workflows that rely on GitLab as the system of record.

description: Provides integration with a GitLab instance to manage projects, issues, merge requests, and more.
